author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam and Joey shoot a One Day Build in a format we've never shot with before: 35MM film! With the help of Kodak, Joey gets Adam's Arriflex 2C film camera running to shoot a small tool build in the cave, and walks us through the production and the process of getting that film developed and processed to edit. 

Find out more about Kodak's motion picture film stocks here: https://www.kodak.com/en/motion/products/camera-films/

Check out more videos on the Arri 2C on the Tested Teams Channel!
Extended Conversation with Sean Charlesworth: https://youtu.be/TrVjBqrPuXA
First film tests with the camera: https://youtu.be/L0KkxgROWZ4
